name: Teen Art Program (TAP)
org: Paris Gibson Square Museum of Art
what_you_do: Make art with other teens in a group at the museum. Food and art supplies are provided.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 15 to 18. You must sign up.
pay_detail: Free to join. Food and art supplies are provided. No stipend is mentioned.
duration: Weekly. The meeting time is not set yet on the program page.
deadline_text: As of an April 2, 2026 update, the program is on a temporary break until the museum finds an instructor.
how_to_apply: Fill out the form on the program page. Or contact Graham Kerwin, Interim Education Manager. Call 406-727-8255. Or email graham@the-square.org.
notes: The program page shows a temporary hiatus in its April 2, 2026 update, until the museum finds an instructor. Call to ask if it has restarted.
